description:
Probe live readiness of the Stripe X402 Payment Hub and its backing Stripe credit ledger. Use this before autonomous workflows or when diagnosing 503 errors; do not use to browse rates (x402_list_capabilities) or read an account balance (x402_get_account).
Behavior: no auth, zero charge, no-store; ok=true requires both hub catalog and credit ledger reachable (<1s typical; 8s ledger timeout fails closed with HTTP 503 and stripe_credit_ledger.reachable=false).
name: x402_check_health

checked_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when readiness was verified.

ok.description: True when both the Payment Hub and Stripe credit ledger are healthy.

paid_capabilities_count.description: Count of active priced HTTP 402 capabilities served by the hub.

reachable.description: True when the backing Stripe credit and policy ledger responded 200 OK.

status.description: HTTP status returned by the ledger health probe.

title: Check X402 Hub Health
